summary: The tasks a procedure needs, each with its state, in the order to do them.

rules.rule: A task name is short and starts with the verb.
Statuses start from 完了 and 未完了; add 対応中, 未着手, 開始できません or 問題があります only when the procedure needs them.
A task that cannot start yet has no link.

labels.status: adjective or completed form, from voice.status

evidence.says: Each task is a link named with a short, verb-first phrase, with an optional hint and a status; a task that cannot start has no link.

evidence.source: GOV.UK Design System, Complete multiple tasks
evidence.says: Start with Completed and Incomplete; add In progress, Not yet started, Cannot start yet and There is a problem as needed.
